summary: Email integration testing complete. All 11 backend tests passed (100%) and frontend UI tests passed (100%). Resend email integration is working correctly - emails are attempted but fail gracefully due to Resend sandbox restrictions for unverified recipients. Core app flows (registration, employee creation, billing checkout, survey submission) continue to work without interruption.
critical_code_review_comments: Email error handling in email_service.py is well-implemented - sanitize_email_error() properly masks sensitive data and provides user-friendly messages
schedule_email_task() in server.py correctly uses asyncio.create_task() to fire-and-forget emails without blocking the main request
send_billing_notification() in billing.py properly logs email delivery status and continues even if email fails
seed_data_creation: Multiple test accounts and employees created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resend email integration is working. Emails fail gracefully due to sandbox restrictions (expected). All core flows work: registration triggers welcome email attempt, employee creation triggers survey invite attempt, billing checkout triggers notification attempt, survey submission triggers completion email attempt. Error handling is graceful - app continues to function.

verified_features.registration_with_email: POST /api/auth/register - succeeds, welcome email attempted (fails gracefully in sandbox)
verified_features.employee_creation_with_email: POST /api/employees - succeeds, survey invite email attempted (fails gracefully)
verified_features.bulk_import_with_email: POST /api/employees/bulk-import - succeeds, multiple survey invites attempted
verified_features.login_flow: POST /api/auth/login - works correctly for accounts created with email integration
verified_features.frontend_registration: Registration form submits, redirects to dashboard with success toast
verified_features.frontend_login: Login form submits, redirects to dashboard with success toast

email_integration_status.error_handling: Graceful - emails fail silently without breaking app flows
email_integration_status.note: Resend returns sandbox restriction errors for unverified recipients. This is expected behavior. To send to other recipients, verify a domain at resend.com/domains.
